fullText.simplified:
第十八章、最后的选择

    引都，楚国的首都，被秦国攻破了。楚国的王和官员们跑了。
    南国的土地上，一棵棵橘树倒下了。到处都是害怕的百姓，大家都在往更远的南方跑，想要远离战火。我站在跑动的百姓中间，看到一张张害怕的、难过的、灰色的脸，觉得天地之间没有光亮了。有老人摔倒了，我扶起老人。有孩子摔倒了，我扶起孩子。摔倒的人越来越多，我扶起一个，又有一个倒下。我扶着扶着，眼泪就流了下来。
    我觉得楚国就像一座高楼，现在这座高楼要倒了。我想扶住它，希望它不要倒，但是我一个人的力气这么小，我怎么扶得住它呢？高楼它最终还是会倒啊！
    我走到一条大河边，看着河水，很长时间都不动。
    后来，一条小船过来了，船上有一个老人。
    老人看到我，问：“你是以前在引都做大官的屈原吗？”
    没想到这儿有人认识我。我点点头。
    老人又问：“你怎么到这儿来了？”
    我说：“世界一片黑，而我一个人坚持白。大家都选择走大路，而我为了理想，坚持一个人走小路。所以我到了这儿。”
    老人笑着说：“聪明的人都知道怎么适应世界。别人黑，你也可以黑。别人走大路，你也可以走大路。你为什么不改变自己呢？”
    我回答：“人洗完澡，一定不会穿脏衣服，因为脏衣服会把干净的身体弄脏。我为了活下去而放弃理想，就像把自己干净的身体弄脏一样，我做不到。”
    老人不说话了，笑着摇了摇头，然后划着小船走了。
    河边又只有我一个人了。风有些冷，我坐在河边，看着灰色的河面。
    我觉得，这个世界上已经没有人懂我了。我没有家，没有路，我想回去的引都没有了。我的心空了，好像里面的东西跟着引都一起没有了。
    那就让我的理想和身体，跟着河水走吧。
    我站起来，慢慢走进河里，一步一步，走向河中间……
fullText.traditional:
第十八章、最後的選擇

    引都，楚國的首都，被秦國攻破了。楚國的王和官員們跑了。
    南國的土地上，一棵棵橘樹倒下了。到處都是害怕的百姓，大家都在往更遠的南方跑，想要遠離戰火。我站在跑動的百姓中間，看到一張張害怕的、難過的、灰色的臉，覺得天地之間沒有光亮了。有老人摔倒了，我扶起老人。有孩子摔倒了，我扶起孩子。摔倒的人越來越多，我扶起一個，又有一個倒下。我扶著扶著，眼淚就流了下來。
    我覺得楚國就像一座高樓，現在這座高樓要倒了。我想扶住它，希望它不要倒，但是我一個人的力氣這麼小，我怎麼扶得住它呢？高樓它最終還是會倒啊！
    我走到一條大河邊，看著河水，很長時間都不動。
    後來，一條小船過來了，船上有一個老人。
    老人看到我，問：“你是以前在引都做大官的屈原嗎？”
    沒想到這兒有人認識我。我點點頭。
    老人又問：“你怎麼到這兒來了？”
    我說：“世界一片黑，而我一個人堅持白。大家都選擇走大路，而我為了理想，堅持一個人走小路。所以我到了這兒。”
    老人笑著說：“聰明的人都知道怎麼適應世界。別人黑，你也可以黑。別人走大路，你也可以走大路。你為什麼不改變自己呢？”
    我回答：“人洗完澡，一定不會穿髒衣服，因為髒衣服會把乾淨的身體弄髒。我為了活下去而放棄理想，就像把自己乾淨的身體弄髒一樣，我做不到。”
    老人不說話了，笑著搖了搖頭，然後划著小船走了。
    河邊又只有我一個人了。風有些冷，我坐在河邊，看著灰色的河面。
    我覺得，這個世界上已經沒有人懂我了。我沒有家，沒有路，我想回去的引都沒有了。我的心空了，好像裡面的東西跟著引都一起沒有了。
    那就讓我的理想和身體，跟著河水走吧。
    我站起來，慢慢走進河裡，一步一步，走向河中間……

sentences.traditional: 南國的土地上，一棵棵橘樹倒下了。

sentences.english: On the land of the southern country, orange trees fell one by one.

sentences.traditional: 到處都是害怕的百姓，大家都在往更遠的南方跑，想要遠離戰火。
sentences.pinyin: dào chù dōu shì hài pà de bǎi xìng dà jiā dōu zài wǎng gèng yuǎn de nán fāng pǎo xiǎng yào yuǎn lí zhàn huǒ
sentences.english: Everywhere, there were frightened people. Everyone was fleeing farther south, hoping to escape the war.

sentences.simplified: 我站在跑动的百姓中间，看到一张张害怕的、难过的、灰色的脸，
sentences.traditional: 我站在跑動的百姓中間，看到一張張害怕的、難過的、灰色的臉，

sentences.english: I stood among the fleeing people, seeing one frightened, sad, gray face after another.

sentences.simplified: 觉得天地之间没有光亮了。
sentences.traditional: 覺得天地之間沒有光亮了。
sentences.pinyin: jué de tiān dì zhī jiān méi yǒu guāng liàng le
sentences.english: I felt that there was no more light between heaven and earth.

sentences.simplified: 有老人摔倒了，我扶起老人。有孩子摔倒了，我扶起孩子。
sentences.traditional: 有老人摔倒了，我扶起老人。有孩子摔倒了，我扶起孩子。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu lǎo rén shuāi dǎo le wǒ fú qǐ lǎo rén yǒu hái zi shuāi dǎo le wǒ fú qǐ hái zi
sentences.english: An old person fell, and I helped the old person up. A child fell, and I helped the child up.

sentences.simplified: 摔倒的人越来越多，我扶起一个，又有一个倒下。我扶着扶着，眼泪就流了下来。
sentences.traditional: 摔倒的人越來越多，我扶起一個，又有一個倒下。我扶著扶著，眼淚就流了下來。
sentences.pinyin: shuāi dǎo de rén yuè lái yuè duō wǒ fú qǐ yí ge yòu yǒu yí ge dǎo xià wǒ fú zhe fú zhe yǎn lèi jiù liú le xià lái
sentences.english: More and more people fell, and as I helped one up, another would fall. As I continued to help, my tears began to flow.

sentences.simplified: 我觉得楚国就像一座高楼，现在这座高楼要倒了。
sentences.traditional: 我覺得楚國就像一座高樓，現在這座高樓要倒了。

sentences.english: I felt that the state of Chu was like a tall building, and now this tall building was about to collapse.

sentences.simplified: 我想扶住它，希望它不要倒，但是我一个人的力气这么小，我怎么扶得住它呢？
sentences.traditional: 我想扶住它，希望它不要倒，但是我一個人的力氣這麼小，我怎麼扶得住它呢？
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng fú zhù tā xī wàng tā bú yào dǎo dàn shì wǒ yí ge rén de lì qi zhè me xiǎo wǒ zěn me fú de zhù tā ne
sentences.english: I wanted to hold it up, hoping it wouldn’t fall, but my strength alone was so small. How could I possibly keep it from collapsing?

sentences.simplified: 高楼它最终还是会倒啊！
sentences.traditional: 高樓它最終還是會倒啊！
sentences.pinyin: gāo lóu tā zuì zhōng hái shi huì dǎo a
sentences.english: The tall building would eventually collapse!

sentences.simplified: 我走到一条大河边，看着河水，很长时间都不动。
sentences.traditional: 我走到一條大河邊，看著河水，很長時間都不動。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zǒu dào yì tiáo dà hé biān kàn zhe hé shuǐ hěn cháng shí jiān dōu bú dòng
sentences.english: I walked to the bank of a great river and gazed at the water for a long time without moving.

sentences.simplified: 后来，一条小船过来了，船上有一个老人。
sentences.traditional: 後來，一條小船過來了，船上有一個老人。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái yì tiáo xiǎo chuán guò lái le chuán shang yǒu yí ge lǎo rén
sentences.english: Later, a small boat came by, with an old man on board.

sentences.simplified: 老人看到我，问：“你是以前在引都做大官的屈原吗？”
sentences.traditional: 老人看到我，問：“你是以前在引都做大官的屈原嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: lǎo rén kàn dào wǒ wèn nǐ shì yǐ qián zài yǐn dū zuò dà guān de qū yuán ma
sentences.english: The old man saw me and asked, “Are you Qu Yuan, who used to be a high official in Yindu?”

sentences.simplified: 没想到这儿有人认识我。我点点头。
sentences.traditional: 沒想到這兒有人認識我。我點點頭。
sentences.pinyin: méi xiǎng dào zhè‘r yǒu rén rèn shi wǒ wǒ diǎn diǎn tóu
sentences.english: Unexpectedly, someone here had recognized me. I nodded.

sentences.simplified: 老人又问：“你怎么到这儿来了？”
sentences.traditional: 老人又問：“你怎麼到這兒來了？”
sentences.pinyin: lǎo rén yòu wèn nǐ zěn me dào zhè‘r lái le
sentences.english: The old man asked again, “How did you end up here?”

sentences.simplified: 我说：“世界一片黑，而我一个人坚持白。
sentences.traditional: 我說：“世界一片黑，而我一個人堅持白。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ shuō shì jiè yí piàn hēi ér wǒ yí ge rén jiān chí bái
sentences.english: I said, “The world is dark, and I alone insist on staying pure.

sentences.simplified: 大家都选择走大路，而我为了理想，坚持一个人走小路。所以我到了这儿。”
sentences.traditional: 大家都選擇走大路，而我為了理想，堅持一個人走小路。所以我到了這兒。”
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā dōu xuǎn zé zǒu dà lù ér wǒ wèi le lǐ xiǎng jiān chí yí ge rén zǒu xiǎo lù suǒ yǐ wǒ dào le zhè‘r
sentences.english: Everyone chooses to walk the main road, but for my ideals, I insist on walking the narrow path alone. That’s why I ended up here.”

sentences.simplified: 老人笑着说：“聪明的人都知道怎么适应世界。别人黑，你也可以黑。
sentences.traditional: 老人笑著說：“聰明的人都知道怎麼適應世界。別人黑，你也可以黑。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo rén xiào zhe shuō cōng ming de rén dōu zhī dào zěn me shì yìng shì jiè bié rén hēi nǐ yě kě yǐ hēi
sentences.english: The old man smiled and said, “Wise people know how to adapt to the world. When others are dark, you can be dark too.

sentences.simplified: 别人走大路，你也可以走大路。你为什么不改变自己呢？”
sentences.traditional: 別人走大路，你也可以走大路。你為什麼不改變自己呢？”
sentences.pinyin: bié rén zǒu dà lù nǐ yě kě yǐ zǒu dà lù nǐ wèi shén me bù gǎi biàn zì jǐ ne
sentences.english: When others walk the main road, you can walk the main road too. Why don’t you change yourself?”

sentences.simplified: 我回答：“人洗完澡，一定不会穿脏衣服，因为脏衣服会把干净的身体弄脏。
sentences.traditional: 我回答：“人洗完澡，一定不會穿髒衣服，因為髒衣服會把乾淨的身體弄髒。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ huí dá rén xǐ wán zǎo yí dìng bú huì chuān zāng yī fu yīn wèi zāng yī fu huì bǎ gān jìng de shēn tǐ nòng zāng
sentences.english: I replied, “After bathing, one would never wear dirty clothes, because dirty clothes would soil a clean body.

sentences.simplified: 我为了活下去而放弃理想，就像把自己干净的身体弄脏一样，我做不到。”
sentences.traditional: 我為了活下去而放棄理想，就像把自己乾淨的身體弄髒一樣，我做不到。”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ wèi le huó xià qù ér fàng qì lǐ xiǎng jiù xiàng bǎ zì jǐ gān jìng de shēn tǐ nòng zāng yí yàng wǒ zuò bú dào
sentences.english: To give up my ideals to survive is like soiling my clean body, and I can’t do it.”

sentences.simplified: 老人不说话了，笑着摇了摇头，然后划着小船走了。
sentences.traditional: 老人不說話了，笑著搖了搖頭，然後划著小船走了。
sentences.pinyin: lǎo rén bù shuō huà le xiào zhe yáo le yáo tóu rán hòu huá zhe xiǎo chuán zǒu le
sentences.english: The old man said nothing more, smiled, shook his head, and then rowed away in his small boat.

sentences.simplified: 河边又只有我一个人了。风有些冷，我坐在河边，看着灰色的河面。
sentences.traditional: 河邊又只有我一個人了。風有些冷，我坐在河邊，看著灰色的河面。
sentences.pinyin: hé biān yòu zhǐ yǒu wǒ yí ge rén le fēng yǒu xiē lěng wǒ zuò zài hé biān kàn zhe huī sè de hé miàn
sentences.english: Once again, I was alone by the river. The wind was a bit cold, and I sat by the river, looking at the gray surface of the water.

sentences.simplified: 我觉得，这个世界上已经没有人懂我了。
sentences.traditional: 我覺得，這個世界上已經沒有人懂我了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ jué de zhè ge shì jiè shang yǐ jīng méi yǒu rén dǒng wǒ le
sentences.english: I felt like no one in this world understood me anymore.

sentences.simplified: 我没有家，没有路，我想回去的引都没有了。
sentences.traditional: 我沒有家，沒有路，我想回去的引都沒有了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ méi yǒu jiā méi yǒu lù wǒ xiǎng huí qù de yǐn dū méi yǒu le
sentences.english: I had no home, no path, and even Yindu, which I wanted to return to, was gone.

sentences.simplified: 我的心空了，好像里面的东西跟着引都一起没有了。
sentences.traditional: 我的心空了，好像裡面的東西跟著引都一起沒有了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ de xīn kōng le hǎo xiàng lǐ miàn de dōng xi gēn zhe yǐn dū yì qǐ méi yǒu le
sentences.english: My heart was empty, as if everything inside had disappeared along with Yindu.

sentences.simplified: 那就让我的理想和身体，跟着河水走吧。
sentences.traditional: 那就讓我的理想和身體，跟著河水走吧。
sentences.pinyin: nà jiù ràng wǒ de lǐ xiǎng hé shēn tǐ gēn zhe hé shuǐ zǒu ba
sentences.english: So, I’ll just let my ideals and body follow the river.

sentences.simplified: 我站起来，慢慢走进河里，一步一步，走向河中间……
sentences.traditional: 我站起來，慢慢走進河裡，一步一步，走向河中間……
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zhàn qǐ lái màn man zǒu jìn hé lǐ yí bù yí bù zǒu xiàng hé zhōng jiān
sentences.english: I stood up and slowly walked into the river, step by step, towards the middle of the river …

sentence_translations: Chapter 18: The Final Choice
Yindu, the capital of Chu, was breached by Qin. The king and officials of Chu fled.
On the land of the southern country, orange trees fell one by one.
Everywhere, there were frightened people. Everyone was fleeing farther south, hoping to escape the war.
I stood among the fleeing people, seeing one frightened, sad, gray face after another.
I felt that there was no more light between heaven and earth.
An old person fell, and I helped the old person up. A child fell, and I helped the child up.
More and more people fell, and as I helped one up, another would fall. As I continued to help, my tears began to flow.
I felt that the state of Chu was like a tall building, and now this tall building was about to collapse.
I wanted to hold it up, hoping it wouldn’t fall, but my strength alone was so small. How could I possibly keep it from collapsing?
The tall building would eventually collapse!
I walked to the bank of a great river and gazed at the water for a long time without moving.
Later, a small boat came by, with an old man on board.
The old man saw me and asked, “Are you Qu Yuan, who used to be a high official in Yindu?”
Unexpectedly, someone here had recognized me. I nodded.
The old man asked again, “How did you end up here?”
I said, “The world is dark, and I alone insist on staying pure.
Everyone chooses to walk the main road, but for my ideals, I insist on walking the narrow path alone. That’s why I ended up here.”
The old man smiled and said, “Wise people know how to adapt to the world. When others are dark, you can be dark too.
When others walk the main road, you can walk the main road too. Why don’t you change yourself?”
I replied, “After bathing, one would never wear dirty clothes, because dirty clothes would soil a clean body.
To give up my ideals to survive is like soiling my clean body, and I can’t do it.”
The old man said nothing more, smiled, shook his head, and then rowed away in his small boat.
Once again, I was alone by the river. The wind was a bit cold, and I sat by the river, looking at the gray surface of the water.
I felt like no one in this world understood me anymore.
I had no home, no path, and even Yindu, which I wanted to return to, was gone.
My heart was empty, as if everything inside had disappeared along with Yindu.
So, I’ll just let my ideals and body follow the river.
I stood up and slowly walked into the river, step by step, towards the middle of the river …
